query: Who is automatically eligible for the Premium Cap and Phased Support provided under MediShield Life?
reference_answer: All Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents, regardless of household income and Annual Value of their residences, are automatically eligible.
context:
[Document 1]
The CPF Board may impose and vary the terms and conditions of the MediShield Life scheme as provided for in the legislation.

[Document 2]
Eligibility for MediShield Life premium subsidies is determined using existing information in Government databases, and no application is needed.

[Document 3]
Members pay premiums ahead during their working ages under MediShield Life, and in return, they enjoy premium rebates during their older ages.

[Document 4]
The Central Provident Fund (CPF) Board administers the MediShield Life Scheme under the provisions of the MediShield Life Scheme Act 2015.

[Document 5]
The deductible under MediShield Life ranges from $2,000 to $4,500, depending on the claimant's age and choice of ward class.
answer: Members who have paid premiums under MediShield Life are automatically eligible for the Premium Cap and Phased Support. [Document 1]
